parts.text: The Temp folder is dominated by `dsh-workspace-changes-*` snapshot directories. Let me quantify those precisely before presenting.

tool_input.command:
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "
\$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'
\$t=\"\$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp\"
\$dirs=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath \$t -Force -Directory -EA SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { \$_.Name -like 'dsh-workspace-changes-*' }
\$sum=0; \$n=0; \$oldest=\$null; \$newest=\$null
foreach(\$d in \$dirs){
  \$s=(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath \$d.FullName -Recurse -Force -File -EA SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum
  if(\$null -eq \$s){\$s=0}; \$sum+=\$s; \$n++
  if(\$null -eq \$oldest -or \$d.CreationTime -lt \$oldest){\$oldest=\$d.CreationTime}
  if(\$null -eq \$newest -or \$d.CreationTime -gt \$newest){\$newest=\$d.CreationTime}
}
'n dsh-workspace-changes dirs: {0}' -f \$n
'Total MB: {0:N1}' -f (\$sum/1MB)
'Creation span: {0:yyyy-MM-dd} .. {1:yyyy-MM-dd}' -f \$oldest,\$newest
'--- WinGet ---'
\$w=(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path \$t 'WinGet') -Recurse -Force -File -EA SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum
'WinGet MB: {0:N1}' -f (\$w/1MB)
"
